summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of USFX Comprobantes app. 35/35 backend pytest tests passed covering auth/JWT, roles (admin/caja/consultas), Estudiantes/TiposPagos/Usuarios CRUD with role enforcement, Pagos creation with atomic correlativo (00001 -> 00002), preview-comprobante, list filters, anular flow (idempotent rejection, admin-only), Reportes (diario/semanal/mensual/rango with totales y diferencia), and Dashboard stats. Frontend E2E tested admin login, sidebar (all 7 links), navigation to /estudiantes, /tipospagos, /usuarios, /anular, /reportes, /registro, /buscar. The critical RegistroPago flow works fully: autocomplete estudiante via Command/Popover, autocomplete tipo de pago, Generar Comprobante shows correlativo NNNNN/YYYY (00003/2026), cantidad recalcula total (3 x 300 = 900,00), Confirmar Comprobante crea pago en BD y dispara window.open para impresión, comprobante se resetea a '—'. Popup Nuevo Estudiante crea estudiante y lo selecciona automáticamente. Reportes muestra secciones Válidos/Anulados/Diferencia/Todos con 3 botones de impresión y 3 botones Excel. Logout funciona. No critical bugs found.

minor.issue: Uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); FastAPI recommends lifespan context manager. Functional but emits DeprecationWarning.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True - browsers reject credentialed requests when origin is wildcard. The login uses Bearer token in tests so it works, but cookie-based auth from a different origin would fail. Consider explicit origins list.
secure=False - acceptable in preview env, but for production over HTTPS it should be secure=True.

action_items: (optional) Migrate FastAPI @app.on_event hooks to lifespan handler.
(optional) Tighten CORS: list explicit origins when allow_credentials=True.
(optional) Consider secure=True for the access_token cookie in production deploy.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (695 lines): single file is approaching the 700-line limit; could be split by domain (auth, users, estudiantes, tipospagos, pagos, reportes).
Correlativo generation correctly uses MongoDB find_one_and_update with $inc and upsert=True - atomic and safe under concurrency.
All Mongo queries explicitly exclude `_id` ({'_id': 0}) - good.
Role enforcement via require_roles dependency is consistent across all sensitive endpoints (PUT/DELETE estudiantes, tipospagos CRUD, anular, reportes, users CRUD).
Admin seed correctly upserts password when ADMIN_PASSWORD in env changes (idempotent).
bcrypt hash format ($2b$) verified via successful login - hash_password uses bcrypt.gensalt() correctly.
JWT auth supports both httpOnly cookie and Authorization Bearer header - dual mechanism works.
Pydantic models validate all input; no raw dict acceptance.
Frontend uses data-testid extensively on all interactive elements - excellent testability.
test_credentials: admin@usfx.edu.bo / admin123 (admin seed). Created via tests: TEST_caja_* and TEST_cons_* (random emails) with passwords caja1234 / cons1234.

Frontend routes are: /estudiantes, /tipospagos, /usuarios, /anular, /reportes, /registro (admin+caja), /buscar (all roles). RegistroPagoPage uses data-testids: estudiante-select-btn, est-option-{id}, tipopago-select-btn, tp-option-{id}, generar-comprobante-btn, cantidad-input, fecha-pago-input, confirmar-comprobante-btn, comprobante-display, total-display, add-new-estudiante-btn, new-est-popup-form, new-est-codigo/ci/cu/nombre/gestion/save. Login uses login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button. For print-window testing, stub window.open via add_init_script. All backend role-based access control verified working.
rca of the issue: No bugs found - first implementation is solid.
